note: Coordinate charts are local maps used to describe regions of a manifold.
Smooth transition maps between charts are part of the manifold atlas structure.
Coordinate transformations are transition rules between overlapping coordinate charts.
A worldline can be understood as a curve passing through ordered spacetime events.
A worldline is a curve lying in the spacetime manifold.
Worldline tangents are examples of tangent vectors at events.
The tangent space is attached to a point of a manifold and supplies the local vector space.
The cotangent space is the dual vector space of linear maps on tangent vectors.
Tensor fields are built from tangent and cotangent spaces assigned point by point.
Tensor fields are built from tangent and cotangent spaces assigned point by point.
Tensor-field components change under coordinate transformations while the underlying geometric object remains the same.
Index notation records tensor type, component slots, and contractions.
The transformation law is built from the Jacobian factors of coordinate transformations.
The law is stated compactly using upper and lower indices.
Tensor fields are recognised by the way their components transform.
